carmen: Heads-up: planning to remove a regional runtime pin in us-east at 01:30 UTC tonight. We'll keep a micro-safelist for customers with known kv-cache handle stickiness. Posting proposal.

hugo: Please call out exact models to remain pinned; last time an ambiguous list caused a surprise.

deploybot: [deploybot] preview patch: ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (2.17)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (2.18)
@@
-  - model: old-gptx
-    reason: longseq-kv-ref
+  # keep old-gptx pinned for enterprise-grade accounts in us-east
+  - model: old-gptx
+    reason: reserved-for-dedicated
+  - model: tiny-alpaca-legacy
+    reason: safelist-for-kv-handle-issues
```

qa-bot: I'll run a 15m SDK v3.5 binding smoke at 00:50 UTC (tokenization + reconnect). Will report pass/fail.

sre-oncall: Rollback thresholds: p50 >12% sustained for 10m OR 5xx >2% for 5m OR any runtime OOM. If triggered, we run: `deploybot rollback --env us-east --runtime 2.17`. I'll watch dashboards.

carmen: Canary plan: 0.5% for 20m, 3% for 40m, then 10% if stable. If QA smoke fails at any stage we hold and re-pin.

qa-bot: SDK smoke: PASS. No tokenization diffs observed.

deploybot: [deploybot] change scheduled for 01:30 UTC. React :thumbsup: to approve or :x: to hold. Applying if >=2 approvals.

hugo: Approving. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Approving and standing by. :white_check_mark:

carmen: Thanks all — will post status updates during ramp. If any anomalies, tag this thread and call out SRE.
